_comment: Configurazione LLM per la conversione SAS -> PySpark. Adattare i valori all'ambiente.

ollama._comment: Host Ollama via env OLLAMA_HOST. Su CPU-only (Azure B2s 2vCPU): qwen2.5-coder:0.5b (~600MB, 7.5tok/s ~30s/blocco). Con GPU o RAM >16GB: qwen2.5-coder:7b o codellama:13b

codestral._comment: API OpenAI-compatible: Codestral/Mistral, vLLM, llama.cpp server. Endpoint = host + /v1/chat/completions
